$comment: THE PERMISSION GATE FOR THE LANDING FIELD (build spec §1).
Every logo shown on this site requires written permission from the company.
A mark is only rendered when BOTH approvedBy and approvedOn are present —
lib/marks.ts drops any that are not and says so in the build log. Nothing
reaches the page by being dropped into /public.
The list is EMPTY on purpose. Two earlier placeholders were built and cut:
floating words from the speech (telling, when the page's whole argument is
showing) and abstract glyphs (they read as clip art and made the page look
like a template). Until real logos are approved the front door carries the
3D YES mark and atmosphere alone — which is the stronger page anyway.
1. Put a monochrome SVG at /public/marks/<company>.svg (single path, no
embedded colour — it is recoloured to the foreground token).
3. They drift in immediately, positioned around the mark and the wordmark.
The same asset pool serves the alumni dossiers' venture marks.
